messages:
Emma G.: Quick one — noticed the runtime guide's /v1/runtime/generate example returns a 400 when I copy-paste it into curl. Link: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/runtime/generate#example
Mike R.: Which example snippet? the JS or the curl?
Emma G.: curl. The body uses `model: \"redwood-v1\"` but our API expects `model_id` now. small change but it breaks copy/paste for anyone testing.
Olga P.: ah yeah that was changed during the model catalog rename. I can open a tiny PR unless someone else wants it.
Emma G.: that'd be great if you have bandwidth. Also can we add the docs frontmatter owner so we don't forget next time?
Olga P.: sure. PR will include frontmatter: `authors: [\"Docs - DevEx\"]` and add `owner: @devex`.
Lucas (devex-bot): Reminder — when fixing samples, run `make docs-test` and verify the live sample playground. CI check: https://ci.internal.redwood.com/12345
Mike R.: heads up, docs-ci-bot just posted a build failure on another PR, so CI queue might be slow :/ :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Emma G.: no rush — just wanted a quick fix before the next onboarding batch uses it.
Olga P.: put up PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1407 — changes: curl snippet param rename, add owner frontmatter, small note in changelog.
Sara L.: thanks! can you also add a one-line migration note under the runtime guide mentioning model_id vs model? new users hit that.
Olga P.: yep will add a short note under the sample section.
docs-ci-bot: Build started for PR #1407
Mike R.: quick review: code snippet looks good, frontmatter ok. left 1 tiny nit about punctuation.
Emma G.: thx both. @Sara L. — can you approve once CI is green? QA picked this up in onboarding testing.
Sara L.: will do after CI passes. :white_check_mark:
docs-ci-bot: Build passed for PR #1407 — https://ci.internal.redwood.com/12345/build/789 (deployed to staging docs)
Lucas (devex-bot): Deployed to staging docs. Live sample validated by bot harness.
Emma G.: verified on staging, sample now works. :party-parrot:
Olga P.: merging now.
Mike R.: optional follow-up: add a tiny test that runs the curl example in CI to catch regressions (file: tests/samples/test_runtime_generate.sh)
Olga P.: added as a follow-up ticket: TKT-981 — small CI sample smoke test. I'll tag the sprint.
Emma G.: perfect. closing the loop — thanks everyone!
